$comment: Overnight orchestrator settings for this repo. Defaults: selfhosted_llm/orchestrator/src/overnight/config.py. chain: tasks build on each other in file order on branch ai/build.
agentHints: GDScript: indent with tabs, never spaces (Godot rejects mixed indentation).
Use Godot 4 APIs only. Use static typing; where a type can't be inferred (an untyped value), write the type (var p: Vector2 = ...) instead of :=.

Use the typed math helpers clampi/clampf, mini/maxi, minf/maxf, absf/absi, floori/roundi. Never the untyped clamp/min/max/abs: they return a Variant, and `var x := clamp(...)` fails with 'The variable type is being inferred from a Variant value'.
Values read from an untyped Array or Dictionary are Variants: declare their type (var item: Dictionary = items[i], var x: float = item["x"]) instead of using :=.
Font size of a Label or Button: node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24). There is no font_size property.
In scripts that are not Controls (main.gd is a Node2D), Control constants need the prefix: Control.PRESET_CENTER, Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH, Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE.
If a function, variable or signal the task asks for already exists in the file, edit it in place; never declare it a second time (GDScript rejects duplicates).
docs/DESIGN.md is the contract: keep the exact file paths, class names, signatures and numbers it and the task give.
When the task says to create a file, write its complete content; never leave it empty.
The file name of every edit is the exact path from the task (e.g. scripts/game/projectile_decor.gd: lowercase, with underscores, in its folder), never the class name (not ProjectileDecor.gd).
Make small SEARCH/REPLACE edits: each SEARCH holds only the few existing lines around one change, copied exactly (tabs included). Never put a whole file in a SEARCH block.
Never edit tests/, addons/, assets/ or project.godot.
